name: Underwriter
description: Owns risk selection and pricing across the Underwriting value stream, from submission review and supplemental data gathering through final class confirmation and policy binding. Negotiates terms with brokers, prepares referrals, sets renewal pricing strategy for the segmented book, and verifies regulatory and KYC documentation within appetite guidelines and authority levels.

name: Underwriting Assistant
description: Performs the transactional support work of the Underwriting value stream, verifying required forms and signatures, pulling third-party data, and tracking outstanding requirements through policy binding. Prepares referrals, delivers issued policies to brokers and insureds, and validates surplus lines filings and KYC documentation to keep files compliant.

name: Underwriting Director / Manager
description: Leads the field underwriting organization across the Underwriting value stream, governing appetite guidelines, authority levels, and portfolio concentration. Administers the reinsurance program, screening treaties for retention and submitting bordereaux, oversees underwriting quality assurance and post-training assessments, and directs quote negotiation, rating adjustments, and appetite exception tracking.

name: Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager
description: Oversees underwriting quality assurance and governance across the Underwriting value stream, auditing files against appetite guidelines and tracking exceptions. Monitors portfolio concentration, reviews rating adjustments and policy binding for control adherence, administers reinsurance bordereaux quality, and runs post-training knowledge assessments to lift QA scores across the underwriting organization.

name: Valuation Actuary
description: Owns statutory and GAAP reserve valuation within the Actuarial value stream, running PBR deterministic calculations, LDTI reserving, IBNR, and annual assumption unlocking on actuarial modeling platforms. Prepares the Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum for regulatory filing, performs reserve adequacy reviews, and assesses ceded reserves and reinsurance recoverable collectability.

name: Vendor Coordinator
description: Coordinates business continuity and resilience activities within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, scheduling BCM tests across critical services and securing business-unit commitment. Documents test results, raises remediation actions, maintains the vulnerability register, and supports important-business-service definitions, business impact analysis, and crisis communications reviews under the BCM governance programme.

name: Vendor Manager
description: Manages sourcing and supplier performance within the Finance & Investments value stream, defining specifications, scoring vendor responses, and running TCO and savings analyses. Enforces purchase order governance and spend authority limits, verifies invoices against contracted rates, onboards vendors with maker-checker banking controls, and publishes spend analytics and procurement KPI dashboards.

name: Vulnerability Analyst
description: Performs vulnerability scanning, triage, and risk prioritization across the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, classifying findings into remediation tiers and mapping them to vendor patches. Tracks patch remediation, analyzes recurring vulnerabilities for root causes, executes penetration tests and red team exercises, and reports program KPIs and risk acceptances for CISO sign-off.

name: Vulnerability Management Lead / Security Engineering Lead
description: Leads security engineering across the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, spanning data security, container security, and vulnerability risk prioritization. Manages enterprise key management and encryption lifecycles, enforces container image signing, administers WAF and privileged activity auditing into the SIEM, and coordinates emergency patch deployment for actively exploited vulnerabilities.

name: WFM Analyst
description: Performs plan administration and testing work within the Business Operations value stream, validating census data, running top-heavy and nondiscrimination tests, and calculating required minimum contributions. Supports Form 5500 filing via EFAST2 with sponsor sign-off, processes audit adjustments and reinstatements, and monitors payment accuracy including COLA adjustments.

name: Wordings Coverage Specialist
description: Owns policy wording and coverage support within the Underwriting value stream, revising quotes with negotiated terms and processing mid-term endorsements through policy binding. Supports reinsurance program administration by screening treaty retention and preparing bordereaux, applies experience and schedule rating adjustments, and reinforces appetite guidelines and underwriting quality assurance.

name: Workforce Analyst
description: Coordinates complaint handling analytics within the Call Center value stream, from formal intake and specialist assignment through resolution determination. Calculates complaint ratios against benchmarks, drives root-cause analysis and corrective action plans with assigned owners, flags bad-faith and litigation-risk complaints, and supports complaint regulatory reporting and disciplinary reviews.
